title: Training Bracket A installation (TRN-1001 practice WI)
operationSummary: Pull the training kit and prepare the bracket parts
instruction: Check the kit against the training pick list and confirm every bag is labeled TRN-1001

title: Training Bracket A installation (TRN-1001 practice WI)
operationSummary: Pull the training kit and prepare the bracket parts
instruction: Deburr every cut edge of the bracket with the hand deburr tool, then wipe with IPA

title: Training Bracket A installation (TRN-1001 practice WI)
operationSummary: Fasten the bracket to the training plate
instruction: Install the four NAS bolts and washers finger tight in a cross pattern

title: Training Bracket A installation (TRN-1001 practice WI)
operationSummary: Fasten the bracket to the training plate
instruction: Torque each bolt to 35 in-lb in a cross pattern and record the value and wrench tag

title: Training Bracket A installation (TRN-1001 practice WI)
operationSummary: Fasten the bracket to the training plate
instruction: Apply a torque stripe across each bolt head and the washer

title: Training Bracket A installation (TRN-1001 practice WI)
operationSummary: Inspect the installed bracket
instruction: Check for burrs, scratches, missing torque stripes and loose hardware

title: Training Harness B routing (TRN-1002 practice WI)
operationSummary: Lay out and check the training harness
instruction: Lay the harness on the training board and match each branch to the board drawing

title: Training Harness B routing (TRN-1002 practice WI)
operationSummary: Lay out and check the training harness
instruction: Confirm every wire label matches the training wire list

title: Training Harness B routing (TRN-1002 practice WI)
operationSummary: Route the harness and secure it with P-clamps
instruction: Route the harness along the marked path with no sharp bends

title: Training Harness B routing (TRN-1002 practice WI)
operationSummary: Route the harness and secure it with P-clamps
instruction: Install the P-clamps every 6 inches and torque the clamp screws to 12 in-lb

title: Training Harness B routing (TRN-1002 practice WI)
operationSummary: Check continuity of every wire
instruction: Measure continuity end to end on each wire with the multimeter and record any reading over 1 ohm

title: Training Harness B routing (TRN-1002 practice WI)
operationSummary: Inspect the routed harness
instruction: Check clamp spacing, bend radius and label orientation

title: Training Panel C assembly (TRN-1003 practice WI)
operationSummary: Clean and prepare the training panel
instruction: Wipe the panel with IPA and let it dry for 5 minutes

title: Training Panel C assembly (TRN-1003 practice WI)
operationSummary: Clean and prepare the training panel
instruction: Measure the four mounting holes with the caliper and record the diameters

title: Training Panel C assembly (TRN-1003 practice WI)
operationSummary: Install the switches on the panel
instruction: Install the three toggle switches with their lock washers

title: Training Panel C assembly (TRN-1003 practice WI)
operationSummary: Install the switches on the panel
instruction: Torque each switch nut to 15 in-lb with the torque driver and record the value

title: Training Panel C assembly (TRN-1003 practice WI)
operationSummary: Inspect the panel
instruction: Check switch orientation and that the legend reads correctly

title: Training Fixture D check (TRN-1004 practice WI)
operationSummary: Measure the training fixture
instruction: Measure the overall length with the caliper and record it

title: Training Fixture D check (TRN-1004 practice WI)
operationSummary: Measure the training fixture
instruction: Measure the locating bore with the micrometer and record it

title: Training Fixture D check (TRN-1004 practice WI)
operationSummary: Install the locating pins
instruction: Press the two locating pins flush with the arbor press

title: Training Fixture D check (TRN-1004 practice WI)
operationSummary: Install the locating pins
instruction: Check each pin height with the height gauge

title: Training Fixture D check (TRN-1004 practice WI)
operationSummary: Inspect the fixture
instruction: Check the recorded dimensions against the training drawing limits

title: Training Mount E assembly (TRN-1005 practice WI)
operationSummary: Prepare the training display mount
instruction: Deburr the mount slots and wipe with IPA

title: Training Mount E assembly (TRN-1005 practice WI)
operationSummary: Install and torque the mount hardware
instruction: Install the six mount screws with thread locker

title: Training Mount E assembly (TRN-1005 practice WI)
operationSummary: Install and torque the mount hardware
instruction: Torque each screw to 20 in-lb and record the value and wrench tag

title: Training Mount E assembly (TRN-1005 practice WI)
operationSummary: Inspect the mount
instruction: Check thread locker coverage and that no screw is cross-threaded
